messages:
hana (Billing): Heads up — we got a ticket from BetaHealth: they received two invoices for March (INV-2026-03-BH and INV-2026-03-BH-dup). One has tax lines, the other doesn't. Both are marked due.
luis (Customer Success): They pasted screenshots. Customer says they paid one already and now accounting is confused. Can we confirm which one is canonical?

billing-bot: invoice-generator | job_2026_03_1812 | status: completed. generated: INV-2026-03-BH
billing-bot: invoice-generator | job_2026_03_1815 | status: completed. generated: INV-2026-03-BH-dup

hana (Billing): That's odd — two consecutive jobs within 3 minutes. Was there a retry path that would create a new invoice instead of updating?

devon (Platform): Checking pipeline — looks like a webhook from usage-aggregator fired twice because of a duplicate ack. Our idempotency key is supposed to be usage_run_id, but one run had a nil usage_run_id due to a parsing error and so a second job created a second invoice.
tom (Finance): Which invoice has the correct amounts? Are the line items the same except the tax?

hana (Billing): Quick diff of line items: both have these items:
```
- subscription_monthly: 15000
- overage_embeddings: 1200
- support: 300
```
But INV-2026-03-BH shows tax_state=CA and tax_amount=1146. INV-2026-03-BH-dup has tax_amount=0 and tax_state missing.

kevin (Payments): If they paid one, payment could be tied to invoice id. Which invoice has the payment recorded? Payment logs show paid_txn linked to INV-2026-03-BH (job_2026_03_1812). The duplicate has no payment.

luis (Customer Success): Customer says they paid the one with tax line. They're worried we'll chase them for the duplicate. They want the duplicate voided and a confirmation email.

tom (Finance): We should void the duplicate and record a ledger entry reversing any outstanding balance. Also need to fix why tax was omitted in the duplicate — could be template variable missing (tax_state pushed by tax-service)

devon (Platform): The parsing bug removed usage_run_id and tax_region in the payload that triggered the second job. Fixing ack handling and adding a guard to drop jobs without usage_run_id. I'll open a PR and patch staging.
hana (Billing): Meanwhile can we mark INV-2026-03-BH-dup as cancelled and send a void letter to BetaHealth? The customer requested immediate confirmation.

billing-bot: invoice-manager | INV-2026-03-BH-dup | set_status: cancelled | reason: duplicate_of_INV-2026-03-BH
billing-bot: ledger | create_reversal | invoice:INV-2026-03-BH-dup | amount:0.00 | note: voided duplicate

kevin (Payments): Reconciliation note: payment remains applied to INV-2026-03-BH. No refunds needed.

hana (Billing): Sending void email now and CC'ing luis. Draft:
"We identified a duplicate invoice (INV-2026-03-BH-dup) generated in error and have voided it. Your payment applies to INV-2026-03-BH. Apologies for the confusion."

luis (Customer Success): Customer confirmed receipt and appreciates quick response.

tom (Finance): Follow-ups:
- add unit test for idempotency when usage_run_id missing
- add validation: jobs without tax_region should fail earlier instead of generating invoice
- notify accounting to ignore INV-2026-03-BH-dup in AR reports

devon (Platform): PR opened: fix/usage-ack-idempotency #483. Deploy slated before midnight PST. Also adding an alert for rapid duplicate invoice creation (>1 invoice for same account within 5m).

hana (Billing): Filing a retro with finance ops to review duplicate handling and a short-run to scan last 48h for duplicates.

tom (Finance): Thanks team. Please attach the cancelled invoice PDF and the reversal note to the ticket. I'll close once the retro is scheduled.
